opennyai_summary.arguments: Learned A.G.A contends that no instructions have been forthcoming from the police authorities.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
There is no good cause for failing to provide instructions to the learned Government Advocate despite advance notice of the bail application.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
opennyai_summary.final__facts:
By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.59 of 2021 at Police Station- Baldeo, District- Mathura under Section 498A, 304B, I.P.C. and 3/4 of D.P. Act.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 02.02.2023.
She committed suicide by hanging.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant -Monu be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
Monu vs State Of U.P. on 6 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168952788/
2
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement rendered by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
